ops.text: Use pnpm as the package manager in this repo. Delete package-lock.json and never run npm install here.
Store all monetary amounts as integer cents, never floats or parseFloat. Use toCents and formatCents from src/lib/money.ts for conversion and formatting.
Do not add new UI libraries in this repo. Build UI with the project's own components in src/ui (Select, Dialog, Button) and never install @headlessui/react.
For new posts in src/content/posts/, set `draft: true` in the frontmatter until the project owner has reviewed them.
Store post images in public/images/<post-slug>/, not src/assets, and use the .webp format.
Place test files next to the file they test, for example src/domain/budget.test.ts. Never create a __tests__ folder in this repo.
Never hand-edit files in src/api/generated. Add new endpoints to openapi.yaml and regenerate the client with `pnpm gen:api`.
Use npm, not pnpm, to install and manage packages in this project. The project has a package-lock.json.
Never leave a pnpm-lock.yaml file in this project. Delete it if one is generated.
Keep business logic out of components. Put calculations in src/domain and expose them to components through a hook in src/hooks.
Store dates in UTC and route all date display and comparisons through src/lib/dates.ts, which uses date-fns-tz with the user's timezone. Never compare local Date values from new Date() directly.
Default the currency selector and money display to GBP, since this is a UK product.
Write all UI copy in British English spelling, for example colour, categorise, and organisation.
Never use emojis in post content, including headings; keep headings plain text.
Before reporting any task as done in this repo, always run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck`. CI failed on lint after a task was reported done without it.
Never commit or push changes in this repo. Leave all changes uncommitted so the project owner can review the diff.
Never use toFixed or multiply or divide by 100 on monetary amounts. Keep money as integer cents end to end and use toCents and formatCents from src/lib/money.ts for conversion and display.
Never use window.confirm for confirmation prompts in this repo. Use the Dialog component from src/ui instead.
This repo uses bun only, not pnpm. Install with `bun install`, run scripts with `bun run <script>`, and do not use pnpm or npm.
Commit each completed task in this repo as one commit with a conventional commit message (feat:, fix:, etc.). Never run git push. This replaces the earlier rule against committing.
Regenerate the API client with `bun run gen:api` after adding endpoints to openapi.yaml. `pnpm` is no longer available in this repo, so `pnpm gen:api` no longer works.
